title: PM E-DRIVE extends EV incentives for two-wheelers till July 2026; e-rickshaws gain till 2028 - The HinduBusinessLine
summary: India's electric two- and three-wheeler makers react positively to the extension of the PM E-DRIVE scheme until March 2028, despite a clear distinction in incentives between the two segments. The policy reset has led to a surge in demand and aggressive pre-buying campaigns by manufacturers.
sentiment_reason: The sentiment is positive due to the extension of the incentive scheme, which supports the growth of the electric three-wheeler segment and encourages manufacturers to move towards a more self-sustaining model, despite the 'registration cliff' for two-wheelers.
